releaseGates.passCondition: Fresh snapshot and both databases reconcile to exactly five source cottage objects.
All 41 source block entities have exact coordinate, full NBT, destination, before hash and after hash; no loss or duplicate.
Every changed cell has an exact source-state forward guard and exact rollback pair; strict-noop preflight passes.
Cell-level attribution reports zero removal of Market-owned or ambiguous cells inside the 65-column overlap.
Old Surveyor shell is nonresidential, fully reconciled and does not narrow the Storehouse-to-Moot public route.
Mason canal water, containment and canal-side walk remain continuous and leak-free.
Zero Grange-owned or ambiguous shared-edge cells are altered.
Architect and Steward documented water columns remain contained and integrated; zero unplanned fluid targets.

Upper Street, East Connector and R07 West Extension form one connected route; carriageways are seven blocks wide, the East Connector is no steeper than 1:5 and all 24 bays pass door-to-street vehicle sweeps.

Exactly five physically attached automotive garages provide exactly 24 usable bays (Architect 6, Steward 6, Mason 4, Surveyor 4, Scott/RRCH-SCOUT 4), five shared walls, five fire-lobby doors, five aprons and five turning envelopes; service/carriage spaces count as zero.
Every public entry has an independently walkable, two-block-headroom pedestrian route protected from garage backing paths by a raised crossing or side walk.
Zero same-level room intersections outside declared transitions; every room is inside its building envelope.
Ten stair systems reach both occupied levels with two-block headroom, usable landings and no ladders as primary routes.

Five non-graphic adult suites contain the scheduled canopy bed, chaise, independently rated suspended lounge, closed storage, dressing and wash zones; they remain outside required egress and have no public sightline.
At least 406 scheduled furnishings/lighting groups exist with every per-house category minimum met.
All 45 camera candidates are collision-free; all five source and five destination before/after pairs preserve eye, lookAt, FOV, time and weather, and every garage has a door/apron evidence view.
Signage and occupant-facing records say Scott House/Scott while RRCH-SCOUT remains a traceable historical alias; resident and cottage references reconcile one-to-one with no duplicate or orphan.
Zero unreviewed intersection with current features, Gilded Raven, new civic work, employee path, streets, farms or protected routes.
Post snapshot, DB import, route QA, floorplans, object-media links and second-pass visual defect report all pass before publication.
